I replied to Dana in her DM: her cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal is 26 September. She set that as a standing date in this same DM on 14 October.

That date is already three weeks past (today is 17 October), and I didn't point that out in the reply. The DM history I can read now only has today's message, so the answer comes from my saved note of what she told me.
